title: PureMac: a free CleanMyMac alternative with zero tracking and built-in auto-cleaning
description:
CleanMyMac costs $40 a year, phones home, and pushes upsell prompts. PureMac does the same job for free. System caches, Xcode derived data, Homebrew cache, APFS purgeable space. No network calls, source code on GitHub if you want to verify. Scheduled auto-cleaning built in. One thing CleanMyMac doesn't have: purgeable space purging via Time Machine snapshots. PureMac does. 

https://github.com/momenbasel/PureMac

#github #opensource
